title: Missing security headers
summary: Three standard security headers are absent, weakening protection against common attacks.
problem: 3 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
